discourse.excerpt: Clay is one, but pots are multifarious; Gold is one, but jewels are varied; Milk is one, though cows are of many colours. The Supreme is One, but wears many vestures.
discourse.theme: The Supreme is One but wears many vestures — see the one Divine behind every form.
discourse.title: The Devotion That God Loves

reflection: Swami says clay is one though the pots are many, and the Supreme is One though He wears many vestures. Today, look past one difference — of faith, face or form — and greet the same Divine in it. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 27, 18 Dec 1994)
seva_nudge: Treat everyone you meet today as the same Divine wearing a different vesture — the same warm greeting, the same patient listening.
